_note: General definitions of dish-name terms. They describe the dish type in general, not this restaurant's version. Every entry starts as reviewed:false; the restaurant must approve each one before launch. Run: node scripts/check-glossary.mjs

dosa.definition: A thin South Indian crepe made from a fermented batter.

idli.definition: A soft, steamed South Indian cake made from a fermented batter.

uttapam.definition: A thick South Indian pancake with toppings cooked into the batter.

vada.definition: A savoury South Indian fritter, often shaped like a ring.

pesarattu.definition: An Andhra-style crepe made from a green gram batter.

upma.definition: A South Indian dish of semolina cooked with tempered spices.

pongal.definition: A South Indian dish of rice and lentils cooked together.

sambar.definition: A South Indian lentil and vegetable stew.

rasam.definition: A thin, tangy South Indian soup.

biryani.definition: A layered rice dish cooked with meat or vegetables and whole spices.

dum.definition: A cooking method where the pot is sealed so the food cooks in its own steam.

pulao.definition: Rice cooked in seasoned stock, often with vegetables or meat.

tikka.definition: Pieces of marinated meat, paneer or vegetables, usually grilled or roasted.

tandoori.definition: Cooked in a tandoor, a cylindrical clay oven.

tandoor.definition: A cylindrical clay oven used for breads and grilled dishes.

kebab.definition: Pieces of meat or vegetables, grilled or roasted, often on a skewer.

seekh.definition: A kebab of minced meat shaped around a long skewer.

paneer.definition: A fresh Indian cheese that holds its shape when cooked.

malai.definition: Hindi for cream; used in the names of rich, creamy dishes.

kulcha.definition: A soft leavened flatbread, often baked in a tandoor.

naan.definition: A leavened flatbread traditionally baked in a tandoor.

paratha.definition: A layered flatbread cooked on a griddle, sometimes stuffed.

gongura.definition: A sour leafy green (sorrel leaves) widely used in Andhra cooking.

chettinad.definition: A cooking style from Tamil Nadu known for freshly ground spice blends.

65.definition: A style of deep-fried, bite-sized dish that originated in Chennai.

manchurian.definition: An Indo-Chinese dish of fried pieces tossed in a savoury sauce.

hakka.definition: An Indo-Chinese style of stir-fried noodles.

schezwan.definition: An Indo-Chinese sauce style named after China's Sichuan province.

makhani.definition: A tomato-and-butter based gravy, as in dal makhani.

masala.definition: A blend of spices, or a dish cooked in one.

korma.definition: A braised dish in a thick sauce, often made with nuts or yogurt.

kadai.definition: A deep, wok-like pan; kadai dishes are cooked in it.

tawa.definition: A flat griddle; tawa dishes are cooked on it.

saag.definition: A dish of cooked leafy greens.

chaat.definition: A family of savoury Indian street snacks.

samosa.definition: A fried pastry with a savoury filling.

pakora.definition: A fritter dipped in gram-flour batter and fried.

gulab jamun.definition: Soft fried dough balls soaked in a sweet syrup.

rasmalai.definition: Soft cheese dumplings in sweetened, thickened milk.

falooda.definition: A layered cold dessert drink with vermicelli and syrup.

lassi.definition: A yogurt-based drink, sweet or salted.

chai.definition: Tea brewed with milk and spices.

irani.definition: Linked to Hyderabad's Irani cafés, known for milky tea.

kothu.definition: Shredded flatbread stir-fried on a griddle.
